summary: Verified the contact-form fix in /app/backend/server.py. Wrote 7 pytest cases covering: root health, POST /api/contact with valid payload, POST with extended mice_data, invalid payload (missing fields), invalid email format, GET /api/contact persistence, and backend log diagnostic message. All 7 tests passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Backend logs confirm the 'RESEND API KEY IS INVALID OR EXPIRED' line is emitted while the endpoint still returns HTTP 200 to the client — the fix is working as intended.

minor.issue: Dead function forward_to_microsoft_forms references undefined names MSFORMS_ID, httpx, json. Never called from any route, but should be removed or fully wired (with imports) to avoid future NameError if invoked.

action_items: User must regenerate the Resend API key at https://resend.com/api-keys and update RESEND_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env to actually receive email notifications. Current key returns 'API key is invalid'.
Optional cleanup: remove or complete the unused forward_to_microsoft_forms function in server.py (has undefined MSFORMS_ID / httpx / json references).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in create_contact is correctly structured: MongoDB insert is inside try/except that raises 500 only on DB failure; email send is fully outside that block and its exceptions are swallowed with a specific log line. Verified end-to-end.
Dead code: forward_to_microsoft_forms uses MSFORMS_ID, httpx, json without imports — would NameError if ever called. Safe today because it is never invoked, but should be removed or completed.

resend.api_key placeholder check `startswith('re_123')` is narrow — could also validate length or use an explicit ENABLE_EMAIL flag. Current invalid key `re_dn5QVa6K...` is a real-looking key so it goes through Resend which then errors, and the error-path log correctly fires ('RESEND API KEY IS INVALID OR EXPIRED').
seed_data_creation: Test rows prefixed with TEST_ inserted into contact_submissions collection during test run (not cleaned up — persistence assertion needs them).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_contact_form.py pass against the public URL. The fix ensures POST /api/contact returns 200 whenever MongoDB save succeeds, regardless of Resend outcome. Logs confirm the diagnostic message 'RESEND API KEY IS INVALID OR EXPIRED' fires with the current invalid key. Frontend testing was explicitly skipped by the review request.
rca of the issue: User perceived the contact form as 'not working' because the frontend showed a failure/no confirmation. Real cause: the RESEND_API_KEY in backend/.env is invalid, so resend.Emails.send raised, and the previous implementation let that exception bubble up producing a non-200 response to the user even though the MongoDB save had already succeeded. Fix: (1) wrap DB insert in its own try/except so only DB failures return 500; (2) move email sending completely outside that try block and swallow exceptions with a distinctive log line; (3) short-circuit to skip Resend entirely when the key is empty or a placeholder ('re_123...'). Verified: endpoint now returns 200 + persisted ContactForm object, and the log line 'RESEND API KEY IS INVALID OR EXPIRED. Generate a new key ... update RESEND_API_KEY in backend/.env' is emitted. Mitigation for email delivery itself: user must generate a new Resend API key and update backend/.env, then supervisorctl restart backend.
